title: I Put the Missing-Yogurt Photo on the Fridge They Moderated

parts.text: I opened the fridge at 12:07 p.m. and only my labeled yogurt was gone. Moderator Skye had pinned a note: LABEL OR LOSE. Mine had a name, a date, and a blue dot. I was twenty-nine, coordinator, holding the empty shelf photo. I put the photo on the fridge they moderated. Skye took the pin down, then put it back over the photo. Facilities printed both. Skye eats unmarked now. The shelf finally looks like a label, not a buffet. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: They moderated the fridge and ate the labeled yogurt — Part 1/1
social.description: Labeled cup, empty shelf, a moderator's pin. The photo stayed. Has an office fridge ever enforced only you?
